request: Analyze GSE214282 and GSE236402 for PMID 38232699 (Single-cell transcriptomics of the immune system in ME/CFS at baseline and following symptom provocation.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq of MACS-purified CD14+CD16- classical monocytes from cryopreserved PBMCs
final.sample_inclusion: 4 female ME/CFS cases (low SF36v2 PCS) and 4 female controls matched for age and BMI, individuals distinct from the scRNA-seq cohort; PBMCs drawn 24 h post-CPET only (S4.4.3.1.p1, S2.3.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Cross-sectional ME/CFS vs control difference in classical monocytes at 24 h post-CPET (validation of the scRNA-seq monocyte signature); no within-subject or between-arm exercise contrast
planned_contrasts: ME/CFS vs control classical monocytes, post-CPET (S2.3.p1, FIG3 A-C; paper reports GSEA and selected genes, no DEG count)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 on STAR GeneCounts, genes with >10 reads in >=3 libraries; log2FC from DESeq2 into fgsea (S4.5.3.p1)
final.paper_results: CCL4 up and CXCR4 down concordant with scRNA-seq; CSF2, CCL20, CCL5, CCL3 up (S2.3.p1, FIG3C)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.3.p1 and S4.4.3.1.p1: classical monocytes from 4 female cases and 4 female controls, PBMCs isolated post-CPET only. GEO series summary agrees ('PBMCs were collected 24h after participants conducted a CPET'). The paper uses this dataset to validate the baseline monocyte case-control signature, not to measure an exercise response.

No DEG threshold is stated for the bulk data.
